name: audit-log
description: Audit logging for Elysia and Better Auth: stores semantic actor/action/target events in audit_logs, including login, ban, role, session, and user lifecycle actions. Requires auth.
env: # audit-log: managed on the admin Settings page, stored in the DB,
# and applied without restart. This environment value is the fallback.
# audit-log: delete entries older than this many days. Unset or 0 keeps them
# forever; set it only when your retention policy requires deleting them.
instructions: Run migrations to create the audit_logs table: {{apiRun}} migration:run{{apiWorkspaceArg}}

Auth/admin actions are recorded by a Better Auth hook. Record semantic application events with AuditService.recordRequest() or recordAudit(); use recordAuditLater() only for high-volume, non-security events.
List entries newest first (admin session required): curl -i -b cookies.txt 'localhost:5002/audit-logs?limit=50' and pass the X-Next-Cursor header back as ?cursor= for the next page
